I re-derived this by case analysis on Finn's slot. Finn in slot 1 is the only starting position that works. Every constraint checks out against this schedule, and the other starting slots fail.

The note in your message is wrong. Ben is in slot 4, not 6, and Ann is in slot 2, so they have exactly one person between them. Gus is in slot 6, which is after Ben, not before him. Slot 6 is Gus's slot, not Ben's.
